segments.text:
V. 8.
Jehoram begat Uzziah—Jehoahaz, Joaſh, and Am•ziah coming between. So that he begat him mediately, as Chriſt is mediately the Son of David and of Abraham So the Progeny of Hezekiah, after many Generations, are called The ſons that ſhould iſſue from him, which he ſhould beget, Iſaiah xxxix. 7.
